acceptance: Q1 1_v7 rewritten form executes at SF1 (or the largest feasible scale) on Trino/Presto without breaching ARRAY_AGG/ORDER BY memory limits, with peak memory and row counts recorded
If limits bind, the array-chunking or pagination remedy is specified in the item before any code change
description: The Q1 DuckDB-LIST to ARRAY_AGG+UNNEST rewrite was motivated by the Presto C++ 100,000-element REDUCE limit, but neither the old limit nor the new ARRAY_AGG ... ORDER BY memory behavior was tested at scale: the Trino 476 smoke could not load SF1 lineitem (memory-connector 128MiB limit) and ran only tpch tiny. A scale run needs a Trino deployment with a real connector (not the memory connector) or a native Presto cluster. This is correctness-adjacent performance verification, not a known failure.
